messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I am following the Garnett tutorial, but in the end, all my cell types are classified as 'Unknown'.

No matter what I try, I get the same result.

Is there a problem with the program? Could you please check?"

messages.subject: Re: cell type Unknown
messages.body_plain:
Hi Alejandro,

Thank you for reaching out! If everything is being classified as "unknown," there are a couple of things to consider:

snRNA-seq version: Did you use single-nucleus RNA-seq data generated before V3? Garnett may not work well with cells that have very low read counts.

Garnett/igraph compatibility: There may also be an issue with the Garnett version and its igraph dependency. Updates to R, Monocle, Garnett, or igraph have occasionally caused compatibility issues with my classifier. One of our students encountered the same problem with a newer version and had to apply a code patch to get it working again. We updated the classifier previously, but another recent update may have caused the issue again.

I will try to update the classifier, but in the meantime, you can use the attached patch.

Please let me know if this works for you!

Sincerely,
Hugo Kim
